t.zh: 证出的证明可以存成元件，以后直接用，不必再开框。几种常用的推理，先各造一个。
t.en: A proof, once wired, can be kept as a part and used from then on without opening a box. First, a part for each of a few moves that come up all the time.

t.zh: 下雨，就地湿；地湿，就路滑。所以下雨，就路滑。凭直觉一步就到，证明核却没有这条规则。
t.en: If it rains, the ground is wet; if the ground is wet, the road is slippery. So if it rains, the road is slippery. One step by instinct, but the kernel has no such rule.

after.zh: 证出来、留着再用的结论叫<wiki-ref to="lemma"></wiki-ref>。这样的元件只是给一段证明起的名字，即<wiki-ref to="definition"></wiki-ref>，不增加能证的东西。
after.en: A proved result kept for reuse is a <wiki-ref to="lemma"></wiki-ref>. Such a part is only a name for a proof, a <wiki-ref to="definition"></wiki-ref>, and adds nothing to what can be proved.

hint.en: The goal is “if it rains, then …”.
